newsitem.title: UK: SECOND CAMELOT DIRECTOR QUITS, JOINS CENTRICA. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SECOND CAMELOT DIRECTOR QUITS, JOINS CENTRICA. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]

text.p: Britain's national lottery operator Camelot Group Plc said on Wednesday that its marketing director Jon Kinsey was quitting his post to join British Gas Trading, a unit of Centrica Plc (corrects to show Kinsey is joining a unit of Centrica not BG Plc).
Kinsey's resignation is the second high-profile defection announced this month at the lottery operator which has been criticised for awarding high salary rises to top executives.
The company's director of communications David Rigg, one of the executives under fire from the new Labour government, is leaving in October.
A spokesman for Camelot said Kinsey would leave in mid-October. He declined to comment on why Kinsey was leaving and said he had no information on his eventual replacement.
A spokeswoman for Centrica said Kinsey would take up the position of marketing and strategy director at British Gas Trading on October 13.
